# Out-of-corpus probes. The first three are SCOPE-ADJACENT — plausible questions about governed
# knowledge and AI systems that this corpus does not cover — because those are the cases abstention
# exists for. Far-domain probes alone would flatter the gate.
Which embedding model should I use for a legal corpus?
How do I calibrate a similarity threshold in practice, step by step?
What does the EU AI Act require of a professional knowledge system?
What is the boiling point of water at sea level?
Who won the 1998 football World Cup?
